answer_1.quote: Multi-document summarization (MDS) requires models to summarize key points across a set of related documents.

answer_2.quote: We compute automated metrics for each generated summary and include instance-level scores in our dataset.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation on the outputs of 6 MDS systems.
answer_4.guideline: Facet-based evaluation uses 8 questions: Fluency, Population, Intervention, Outcome, Effect-target, Effect-generated, Strength-target, Strength-generated. Pairwise evaluation asks 'Which of A or B more accurately reflects the content of the target summary?'
